description_en: Supports structured content detection and recognition for passports of the People's Republic of China, including passports from the Chinese mainland, Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), and Taiwan (China). Detected fields include place of birth, date of birth, nationality, gender, passport number, validity period end date, issuing country, issuing location, and more
description_zh: 支持中国人民共和国护照的结构化内容检测识别功能，支持中国内地、中国香港、中国澳门和中国台湾地区的护照识别，识别内容包括出生地、出生日期、国籍、性别、护照号码、有效期至、签发国、签发地等字段
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-chinese-passport --url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i1/O1CN01UNXHMC1FJTGRkdCgT_!!6000000000466-0-tps-1500-1125.jpg' --biz-body '图片二进制' --output-figure true --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeChinesePassport
